Keywords: Recognizing armed boats at river settlements
RagShortTexts: Armed river travelers may escort or rob, requiring attention to identity and conduct.
Narrow channels and landings expose traffic, making watches and reliable contacts important.

Variants.Content: Armed river parties include escorts, followers and men who prey on unloading crews, without automatic backing from a city or lord. Narrow channels, shallows and landings reduce maneuver. News and shore support matter. Owners need guards and known companions to avoid retaliation for someone else's plunder.

Riverside families seek recognition of armed arrivals before trading or moving animals. Stolen food and nets threaten livelihoods, while claims require witnesses. Merchants paying fairly gain future hospitality and guidance; tolerated looting can destroy those relationships after one visit.
